What's your return and refund policy?
Our return policy provides a 30-day return window for eligible orders placed directly on NANUK.com.
Return/refund basics
You may request a refund or replacement within 30 days of delivery.
Items must be in new, perfect, and resalable condition.
All accessories, original packaging, and proof of purchase are required.
A Return Authorization must be issued before returning any items.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method after the return is inspected.
Return shipping
Generally, the customer is responsible for return shipping.
If the return is due to an error on our part, we will cover the shipping.
Important exclusions
This policy applies only to purchases made on NANUK.com.
Purchases from third-party sites, wholesale orders, or authorized retailers are subject to the return policy of the original seller.
